title: From Prompting to Composing: A Spatial Canvas Interface for Poster Generation
abstract: Text prompting is an indirect interface for poster generation, requiring users to encode inherently two-dimensional composition intent into a one-dimensional sequence of words. We introduce a Spatial Canvas Interface that enables users to directly compose generation intent in space through four complementary binding types: semantic, identity, text, and pixel, together with Text Specifications for individual elements and global appearance. Based on this interface, we develop Compo, a poster generation model adapted from a pretrained image editing model to understand Spatial Canvas inputs and Text Specifications. Compo supports both direct inference, where users explicitly construct the canvas, and agentic mode, where a high-level request is automatically translated into a planned Spatial Canvas. To train Compo, we develop a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs supervision data for different binding types and their combinations, enabling efficient adaptation without training a specialized poster generator from scratch. We further introduce a benchmark that evaluates adherence to individual binding types and their joint composition. Experiments show that Compo achieves stronger compositional controllability than both general-purpose image generation models and dedicated poster generation systems while maintaining high visual quality. By decoupling intent specification from visual generation, our work shifts poster generation from prompting toward composing.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.12230v1 的 38 页全文与关键图表核验整理。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: 把poster创作转为2D Spatial Canvas上的semantic/identity/text/pixel binding，再用LoRA＋binding-awareDiffusionNFT适配image-editing模型。作者报告500合成benchmark的layout/文字/identity控制显著改善；值得深读设计intent中间表示，但‘pixel’允许style/lighting变化，输出不是可编辑多层或SVG，agentmode尚无独立定量闭环评估。
analysis.motivationZh: Poster 的元素位置、尺寸、身份与文字关系难以用一段 prompt 精确表达；全图生成也容易忽略局部布局要求。需要一种让用户明确指定空间构图、同时保留生成自由度的输入方式。
analysis.methodZh: 黑canvas把每element的bbox、placeholder、referenceimage或category显式画出，TextSpecifications提供elementactions/typography及globalbackground/style。200Ksyntheticposters用segmentation/OCR反构canvas和spec；identityreference经repose，pixelcopy，semantic仅regionlabel。FrozenVLM+VAE将canvas/spec输入既有MMDiT，rank128LoRASFT后新增rank64LoRADiffusionNFT，textaccuracy/NED、instanceCLIP/DINO和layoutIoU0.4/0.4/0.2组合。Directmode支持人规划，agentmodeGPTplanning＋referenceverification可构同input；结构化designcontrol是方法主贡献。
methodFlow: 表达typed spatial bindings：text框用txt-ID映射exactcopy，identityreference用obj-ID和action，semantic框label与description，pixelasset直接paste，globalstyle/background另spec。
反构paired设计监督：LLMplan生成1024poster，SAM3seginstance/OCRrecognition定位；以实际OCRtext为GT而非原plan，FLUXrepose/relightreferences。
human或planner驱动生成：人工canvas/spec或GPTextract/layout/binding，identity可Openverse检索/T2Ifallback并SAM3后验证，再Compo单poster生成。
analysis.experimentsZh: 200Ktrain，12themes/约1000contentitems/250styles，train3–8instances；500curatedsynthetictest4–9instances，noexacttrainingoverlap；14generalediting和3postermethodnativeinputs；rank/rewardablationLongCatonly。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告LongCatTextBindingNED0.970/sentence0.940/IoU0.944；Qwen0.940/0.868/0.934，subject/Layoutmetrics强化。（PDF p.7, Table1; p.19, Table5）；作者报告no-rewardoverallAvg0.725→full0.752，layoutrewardremoval0.750，较小marginaleffect无CI；newthemesqualitative非统计OODtest。（PDF p.9, Table2; p.22, Figure8） 对照范围：专用posterformats不支持全部fourbinding，信息保留只在nativecapability范围；通用editingmodels未为canvas界面adapt，对比包含200Kinterface训练优势；未比较同dataset不同structuredinput或text-only输入的净interfacegain。 消融与诊断：rewardcomponents、sentenceweight0–1、LoRAimage/textbranches及SFT/RL；未给repeatedseeds/userstudy、agentmodequantification或layoutcomplexity/numbindings分层结果。
analysis.insightZh: heterogeneousbindings统一到visualcanvas及typedtextmapping，结合syntheticpaireddata与task-specificposttraining；其价值是designconditioninginterface而非新diffusionfoundationarchitecture。agent流程是辅助workflow，无独立贡献验证不单列visual-design-agents主主题。
analysis.evidenceZh: 四binding区分所需可控性而不是所有reference都exactcopy。（PDF pp.1–3, Figure1; p.17, AppendixA.1; pp.31–35, AppendixD.3）；两backbonebindingcontrol领先，但synthetic同源benchmark和rewardmetrics重合。（PDF pp.7–9, Tables1–4; pp.17–19, AppendicesA/B）；posttraining提升有实证，text/identity权重存在tradeoff。（PDF p.9, Tables2–3; p.19, Table5）；agentmode具体，但verification仅reference，不是iterativefinaldesignrepair。（PDF p.6, Figure4; p.19, AppendixB.3; pp.31–38, planning/verificationprompts）
analysis.caveatZh: image/model/assets使用来源license；模型为pretrainededitingadaptation，文中无专节technicallimitations。；matchingIoUthreshold数值未明确、maximumIoU非说明one-to-oneassignment，同category多instance匹配可靠性待核验。；semantic/identity/pixelregion自动seg与同rewardmetric可能放大scores，缺独立human/designqualityevaluation。；训练数据OCRrecognizedtext可能改掉原intent，HorizontalEnglishshortcopy规则限制书写/复杂版式generalization。；官方repo当前README/assets展示，未确认implementation/weightsreleased；SFT/RL总steps及耗时未完整量化。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接是structured2Ddesigngeneration与用户可控composition，能迁移SVG/layout/designintent的intermediaterepresentation思路；输出当前raster，high/deep关注bindings而非夸大editableassets。
